item: Byte-identical private helpers (_walk_no_score x6, _median_ms x2, _coerce_bool x2, safe_snapshot x2, _report_dir/_all_diagnostics_dir x3) moved to one home each (A-036, R446)
summary: Audit A-036: 17 private copies across 17 files became 5 shared helpers, behaviour unchanged. src/shared.py (stdlib only): walk_no_score, median_ms, coerce_bool, snapshot_or_unavailable; src/paths.py: diagnostics_dir. The old names stay where tests patch them (_report_dir in card_audit and p0_validation, _all_diagnostics_dir in the diagnostics bundle are now imports of diagnostics_dir). Found a THIRD _report_dir copy (monitoring/p0_validation.py) that the audit's name scan had split off because its signature carries a return annotation. Left out as ruled: the sleep-interruptible family (WAL's frame budget), _default_get (two lanes, comment-only drift), the 29 drifted same-name pairs (each is a behaviour question for its owning lane). tests/test_shared_helpers_folded.py pins both halves: the behaviour of each helper and that no private copy is defined again (a re-added copy turns it red).
